coverage.note: All 67 VBM county originals and 37 required early-voting county originals verified for October 22. The other 30 counties had not opened early voting for the prior reporting day. Martin and St. Johns are newly reporting early voting. All county-party totals reconcile to the 8:05 AM state compilation. No prior voter records substituted. Changes compare October 21 and October 22 at 8:05 AM ET (24 hours), and are reported-count changes rather than votes necessarily cast that day. Source-date exception: 26 Sarasota early-voting records show October 12; retained as reported and reconciled to official counts, not interpreted as verified voting on that date.

definitions.provided: VoteByMail status P (provided, not yet returned).
definitions.returnRate: Returned divided by sent/provided universe (V ÷ (P + V)).
definitions.early: Reported early in-person ballots from the separate EVL archive
definitions.cast: VBM returned plus early in-person ballots; zero cross-method duplicate returned voters verified
